MANDARIN — MOCK EXAM #10
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MANDARIN
TIME ALLOWED: 90 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 80
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which greeting is the polite way to say hello to a teacher? (1 mark)
   A. 谢谢 xièxie
   B. 再见 zàijiàn
   C. 您好 nín hǎo
   D. 我叫 wǒ jiào

2. Which initial is said with a puff of air? (1 mark)
   A. b
   B. p
   C. m
   D. f

3. How does the voice move in the second tone? (1 mark)
   A. It dips and rises
   B. It falls sharply
   C. It stays flat
   D. It rises

4. Which Chinese word means "younger brother"? (1 mark)
   A. 哥哥 gēge
   B. 弟弟 dìdi
   C. 妈妈 māma
   D. 有 yǒu

5. Which Chinese word means "where"? (1 mark)
   A. 哪儿 nǎr
   B. 门 mén
   C. 卧室 wòshì
   D. 旁边 pángbiān

6. What does 今天星期几? jīntiān xīngqī jǐ? ask? (1 mark)
   A. Where is school?
   B. What is your name?
   C. How many people are there?
   D. What day of the week is it today?

7. What does 昨天 (zuótiān) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Mosque
   B. Yesterday
   C. Week (short form)
   D. To go

8. Which sentence means "Today is Wednesday."? (1 mark)
   A. 我星期三去学校。
   B. 今天星期三。
   C. 星期天,去教堂。
   D. 星期五,去清真寺。

9. What does it mean to listen for gist? (1 mark)
   A. To find the main idea
   B. To stop listening
   C. To write every word
   D. To repeat every word

10. Which word means "gift"? (1 mark)
   A. 杯子
   B. 礼物
   C. 蜡烛
   D. 盘子

11. What does 切 (qiē) mean? (1 mark)
   A. To wish
   B. They
   C. To cut
   D. Friend

12. Which Chinese word means "meat"? (1 mark)
   A. 肉 ròu
   B. 饼 bǐng
   C. 水 shuǐ
   D. 吃 chī

13. Fill the blank: 我____茶。 (I drink tea.) (1 mark)
   A. 去
   B. 喝
   C. 吃
   D. 看

14. What does 饮料 (yǐnliào) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Meat
   B. Dinner
   C. Drinks
   D. Beef

15. What does 摸 (mō) mean? (1 mark)
   A. To laugh, to smile
   B. To touch
   C. To cry
   D. To brush teeth

16. What does 浴室 (yùshì) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Where
   B. Bathroom
   C. Sofa
   D. Below

17. Why do we read greetings with a friendly face? (1 mark)
   A. It hides the words
   B. It changes the voice to sound friendly
   C. It makes the words longer
   D. It changes the tones

18. In the rhyme 妈妈骑马,马慢,妈妈骂马, what does 骂 mà mean? (1 mark)
   A. Mother
   B. To ride
   C. To scold
   D. Slow

19. What does 七 (qī) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Seven
   B. Ten
   C. Six
   D. Five

20. What does 我们 (wǒmen) mean? (1 mark)
   A. They
   B. Everybody
   C. Candle
   D. We

21. What does 芒果 (mángguǒ) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Coffee
   B. To like
   C. Biscuits
   D. Mango

22. Which character has an extra line on top of 大? (1 mark)
   A. 入
   B. 太
   C. 人
   D. 天

23. Which two words share the final -ang? (1 mark)
   A. 小 xiǎo and 早 zǎo
   B. 好 hǎo and 老 lǎo
   C. 门 mén and 手 shǒu
   D. 房 fáng and 旁 páng

24. What is the main idea of a text? (1 mark)
   A. What the whole text is about
   B. The first letter
   C. The last word
   D. The title font

25. What does 花园 (huāyuán) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Living room
   B. Garden
   C. Sofa
   D. Beside

26. Which sentence is correct for "The chair is under the table"? (1 mark)
   A. 椅子在桌子下。
   B. 在椅子桌子下。
   C. 椅子下在桌子。
   D. 桌子在椅子下。

27. What does 快乐 (kuàilè) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Happy
   B. Cake
   C. Birthday
   D. Plate

28. Which sentence means "This is a banana."? (1 mark)
   A. 我喝茶。
   B. 我早饭吃饼。
   C. 这是什么?
   D. 这是香蕉。

29. Which Chinese word means "left side"? (1 mark)
   A. 门 mén
   B. 东西 dōngxi
   C. 左边 zuǒbian
   D. 客厅 kètīng

30. Fill in the blank: 浴室在花园____。 (beside) (1 mark)
   A. 左边
   B. 下面
   C. 旁边
   D. 上面

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "Who is this?" (2 marks)

32. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 午饭 and 快乐. (2 marks)

33. Write a dialogue of five lines in Chinese with pinyin between two learners about a food picture: ask what it is, answer, ask if they like it, and reply. (5 marks)

34. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 喝 and 牙. (2 marks)

35. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 七 and 云. (2 marks)

36. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "The chair is under the table." (3 marks)

37. Write five sentences about body parts and what they do, with pinyin. (5 marks)

38. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 花园 and 房子. (2 marks)

39. Read the rhyme 妈妈骑马,马慢,妈妈骂马 and explain how the tone changes meaning. (4 marks)

40. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "I like to drink tea." (2 marks)

41. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 清真寺 and 一. (2 marks)

42. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 肉, 用 and 摸. (3 marks)

43. Give two things to put in a reading journal. (2 marks)

44. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "Today is Wednesday." (2 marks)

45. Explain two things that help you read a sentence at a good pace. (4 marks)

46. Write in characters the days Friday, Saturday and Sunday. (3 marks)

47. Write in Chinese and pinyin: "Today it rains." (2 marks)

48. Decide whether each statement is 对 or 错 and explain. Text: 今天有太阳,没有雨。 Statement: 今天有雨。 (3 marks)
pages.answers:
MANDARIN — MOCK EXAM #10 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. C — 您好 nín hǎo
   您 is the polite form of you.

2. B — p
   p has a puff of air, while b does not.

3. D — It rises
   The second tone rises, like asking "What?"

4. B — 弟弟 dìdi
   弟弟 (dìdi) means younger brother.

5. A — 哪儿 nǎr
   哪儿 (nǎr) means where.

6. D — What day of the week is it today?
   几 asks which number, so 星期几 asks which day of the week.

7. B — Yesterday
   昨天 (zuótiān) means yesterday.

8. B — 今天星期三。
   今天星期三。 (jīntiān xīngqīsān.) means "Today is Wednesday.".

9. A — To find the main idea
   The gist is the main idea of the message.

10. B — 礼物
   礼物 lǐwù is a gift.

11. C — To cut
   切 (qiē) means to cut.

12. A — 肉 ròu
   肉 (ròu) means meat.

13. B — 喝
   We drink tea, so we use 喝.

14. C — Drinks
   饮料 (yǐnliào) means drinks.

15. B — To touch
   摸 (mō) means to touch.

16. B — Bathroom
   浴室 (yùshì) means bathroom.

17. B — It changes the voice to sound friendly
   A smile changes the sound of your voice.

18. C — To scold
   骂 is to scold.

19. A — Seven
   七 (qī) means seven.

20. D — We
   我们 (wǒmen) means we.

21. D — Mango
   芒果 (mángguǒ) means mango.

22. D — 天
   天 tiān is 大 with a line on top.

23. D — 房 fáng and 旁 páng
   fáng and páng both end in ang.

24. A — What the whole text is about
   Details support the main idea.

25. B — Garden
   花园 (huāyuán) means garden.

26. A — 椅子在桌子下。
   thing + 在 + place + 下.

27. A — Happy
   快乐 (kuàilè) means happy.

28. D — 这是香蕉。
   这是香蕉。 (zhè shì xiāngjiāo.) means "This is a banana.".

29. C — 左边 zuǒbian
   左边 (zuǒbian) means left side.

30. C — 旁边
   旁边 is beside.

SECTION B
----
31. (2 marks)
   Answer: 这是谁? zhè shì shéi?
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

32. (2 marks)
   Answer: 午饭: wǔfàn, lunch. 快乐: kuàilè, happy.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

33. (5 marks)
   Answer: A: 这是什么? zhè shì shénme? B: 这是香蕉。 zhè shì xiāngjiāo. A: 你喜欢吃香蕉吗? nǐ xǐhuan chī xiāngjiāo ma? B: 我喜欢。 wǒ xǐhuan. A: 谢谢! xièxie!
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each line with pinyin.

34. (2 marks)
   Answer: 喝: hē, to drink. 牙: yá, tooth.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

35. (2 marks)
   Answer: 七: qī, seven. 云: yún, cloud.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

36. (3 marks)
   Answer: 椅子在桌子下。 yǐzi zài zhuōzi xià.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters in the correct order, 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks, 1 mark for punctuation.

37. (5 marks)
   Answer: 我用眼睛看。我用耳朵听。我用嘴巴说。我有两只手。我有两只脚。 wǒ yòng yǎnjing kàn. wǒ yòng ěrduo tīng. wǒ yòng zuǐba shuō. wǒ yǒu liǎng zhī shǒu. wǒ yǒu liǎng zhī jiǎo.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each sentence with correct pinyin.

38. (2 marks)
   Answer: 花园: huāyuán, garden. 房子: fángzi, house.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

39. (4 marks)
   Answer: Māma qí mǎ, mǎ màn, māma mà mǎ. Mum rides a horse, the horse is slow, mum scolds the horse. The syllable ma changes meaning with the tone: mā mother, mǎ horse, mà scold.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the pinyin, 1 mark for the meaning, 2 marks for explaining the three ma words.

40. (2 marks)
   Answer: 我喜欢喝茶。 wǒ xǐhuan hē chá.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

41. (2 marks)
   Answer: 清真寺: qīngzhēnsì, mosque. 一: yī, one.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

42. (3 marks)
   Answer: 肉: ròu, meat. 用: yòng, to use. 摸: mō, to touch.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

43. (2 marks)
   Answer: New words with pinyin and meaning, sentences you can read well, or a recording of yourself reading.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

44. (2 marks)
   Answer: 今天星期三。 jīntiān xīngqīsān.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

45. (4 marks)
   Answer: Read it slowly first; join the words together; speak at natural speed; keep the tones clear; record and listen back.
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for each explained point.

46. (3 marks)
   Answer: 星期五, 星期六, 星期天.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

47. (2 marks)
   Answer: 今天下雨。 jīntiān xià yǔ.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin.

48. (3 marks)
   Answer: 错. The text says there is no rain (没有雨).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for 错, 1 mark for finding 没有, 1 mark for the explanation.
